theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type} [Field k] [Group G] (r : G →* (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (A B N : Rep.{0} k G) (φ : A →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] N), (∀ (s : G) (a : A) (b : B), φ (A.ρ s a) (B.ρ s b) = N.ρ s (φ a b)) → ∃ P : A.ρ.invariants →ₗ[k] groupCohomology.continuousH2 r B →ₗ[k] groupCohomology.continuousH2 r N, ∀ (m : A.ρ.invariants) (z : groupCohomology.levelCocycles₂ r B), ∃ e : groupCohomology.levelCocycles₂ r N, (∀ st : G × G, (e : G × G → N) st = φ (m : A) ((z : G × G → B) st)) ∧ P m (groupCohomology.continuousH2π r B z) = groupCohomology.continuousH2π r N e
